basics.name: John Doe
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with 8+ years of experience building backend services and product-facing web applications. Comfortable owning features end to end: design, implementation, testing, and production support. Interested in well-factored systems, readable code, and helping teams ship reliably.

work.name: Northwind Analytics
work.summary: Backend engineer on the customer platform team, building APIs and data pipelines that power a B2B analytics product.
highlights: Owned billing APIs: Designed and shipped REST services for subscription and usage billing, including idempotent retries and audit logging.
Cut p95 latency: Replaced N+1 query paths with batched reads and Redis caching, reducing p95 API latency from 420ms to 110ms.
Improved delivery: Introduced contract tests and GitHub Actions checks that caught breaking API changes before merge.
Mentored engineers: Pair-programmed with two mid-level engineers and ran weekly design reviews for the team.

work.name: Harborline
work.summary: Full-stack engineer on a logistics SaaS product used by warehouse and last-mile operations teams.
highlights: Shipped the dispatch board: Built a React + TypeScript UI backed by Node.js services for real-time job assignment.
Event-driven updates: Added a small Kafka consumer path so the UI reflected status changes without polling.
Database work: Modeled order and stop tables in Postgres, including migrations and query tuning for the busiest screens.
On-call: Participated in a weekly on-call rotation and wrote runbooks for the most common production incidents.

work.name: PixelForge
work.summary: Worked on internal tools and a customer-facing marketing site for a digital studio.
highlights: Internal admin tools: Built CRUD dashboards in JavaScript and Python for project tracking and asset management.
Automated deploys: Replaced manual FTP releases with a simple CI pipeline to staging and production.
Bug fixing: Triaged and resolved production issues across the marketing site and CMS integrations.
